trial_title: A Phase Ib Study of ISF35 in Combination With Chemotherapy (FCR) in Subjects With Relapsed, Refractory, and/or 17p- CLL
brief_summary: The study is a Phase 1b open label, non-randomized, single institution clinical trial that is designed to evaluate the safety and tolerability of three repeat infusions of ISF35 followed by a standard regimen of three cycles of fludarabine, cyclophosphamide and rituximab (FCR) in subjects with refractory, resistant, and/or 17p- CLL.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subjects must have CLL that is documented to be resistant or refractory to standard chemotherapy regimens containing alkylating agents and/or purine analogues. Chemotherapy refractory or resistant is defined as the following:
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has CLL and has undergone multiple chemotherapy regimens, indicating resistance or refractoriness.

eligibility_table.criterion: CLL progression during treatment (2 cycles) with chemotherapy; OR
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has undergone multiple cycles of chemotherapy, suggesting progression during treatment.

eligibility_table.criterion: Failure to achieve a PR or CR after at least 2 cycles of chemotherapy; OR

eligibility_table.criterion: No response to treatment or stable disease after at least 2 cycles of chemotherapy; OR

eligibility_table.criterion: Disease progression within 6 months of treatment with chemotherapy; OR
